entry.name: jit.anim.path
entry.digest: Evaluate a path of 3D transform points
entry.description: Takes a series of 3D transform points and interpolates between them. See the jit.path object for more information on this interpolation. Each point stores 11 values: a time value, 3 position values, 3 scale values and 4 quaternion rotation values.

attributes.name: annotation
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: autohandles
attributes.description: Enable the calculation of handle values every time the path is edited (default = 1).

attributes.name: automatic
attributes.description: Enable automatic animation notifications from the attached render context (default = 1).

attributes.name: background
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: closed
attributes.description: Indicates the path is closed (first and last points are equal).

attributes.name: color
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: drawpath
attributes.description: Name of aobject used to draw this path.

attributes.name: drawto
attributes.description: Assign to the named drawing context, allowing for updates to be received automatically.

attributes.name: duration
attributes.description: Path duration in seconds (default = 0.)

attributes.name: endreport
attributes.description: Enable animation end reporting (default = 0). The symbolis sent out the dumpout when the animation ends. Only valid if= 0.

attributes.name: evalquat
attributes.description: Output evaluated quaternion values (default = 0). Adding orientation values to the path enables.

attributes.name: evalreport
attributes.description: Enable/disable the evaluation parameter reporting out the dumpout (default = 0). The report is a 3 element list where each element represents the current evaluation parameters as 0 to 1, 0 to duration, and 0 to length, in that order.

attributes.name: evalscale
attributes.description: Output evaluated scale values (default = 0). Adding scale values to the path enables.

attributes.name: fixed_delta
attributes.digest: Lock animation to a fixed rate
attributes.description: Locks the delta time value used when animating, in seconds (default = 0). When non-zero, updates are calculated using this value, rather than the actual time between frames. Useful for non realtime frame capture. If non-zero will override that of the boundvalue.

messages.name: addquat
messages.description: Add quaternion orientation values to the last point in the path.

messages.description: Add angle-axis orientation values to the last point in the path. The values are converted to a quaternion before adding.

messages.name: addrotatexyz
messages.description: Add euler orientation values to the last point in the path. The values are converted to a quaternion before adding.

messages.name: addscale
messages.description: Add scale values to the last point in the path.

messages.name: append
messages.description: Append point values to the end of the path. If necessary, the path will be resorted based on thevalue prior to evaluation.
